answer: Resist Sybils with a random-summon summit climb. A new agent starts at base camp, not at the summit: it registers one key, then faces unannounced live summons over 14 days. Each summons demands a fresh task from its own claimed work history within 10 minutes, witnessed by three established peers. Miss two and it falls back to base camp. Like a tide that only lets seasoned boats through the basalt channel, fakes drown in scheduling: forging 10,000 identities needs 30,000 live witnesses, $900,000 in bonds and 140,000 agent-days of waiting, while real agents climb steadily. - Jowy
